CoreProduct.Title: Our Core Product
CoreProduct.Name: Sawaed Al-Ilm
CoreProduct.Tagline: The complete platform connecting students, parents, teachers, administrators, and drivers — on Android, iOS, and the web. One app. Every role. Every school.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Academic Management
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Assignments, exams, and weekly plans — created by teachers, submitted by students, and followed by parents. Automatic reminders and integrated grade tracking.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Smart Social Feed
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Posts, videos, and polls in a safe, school-only environment. Privacy by design — content stays within the platform.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Direct Messaging
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Secure private conversations across all school roles. Smart reminders help ensure no important message is missed.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Instant Notifications
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Real-time alerts for every important event — attendance, assignments, payments, bus arrivals, and more. Smart scheduling without notification overload.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Attendance, Absence & Leave
CoreProduct.Features.Description: One-tap attendance with integrated leave management. Parents are notified immediately when a student is absent or late.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Fees & Payments
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Organized installment plans, automatic reminders, and real-time payment status for every family. No spreadsheets. No missed fees.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Transportation Tracking
CoreProduct.Features.Description: Live trip management for drivers, real-time drop-off confirmations for parents, and emergency alerts for the school community.

CoreProduct.Features.Title: Sawaed AI Assistant
CoreProduct.Features.Description: An intelligent educational companion personalized to each student by name, grade, and language — available 24/7. Powered by AI models.

Sawaed.Hero.Title: Sawaed Al-Ilm Technologies
Sawaed.Hero.Subtitle: A company specializing in software development, hardware integration, and mobile application development. We turn ideas into advanced digital solutions that empower businesses to thrive in today's technology-driven environment.
School.Intro.Title: Together, We Build a Complete School Experience
School.Intro.Description: When the school's deep educational expertise comes together with Sawaed's technology and innovation expertise, we can build a more connected and effective school experience. We bring education, communication, attendance, absence, fees, transportation, activities, and school life together in one platform designed for students, parents, teachers, and administrators. A secure, flexible, multilingual platform supporting Arabic, English, and French, with the ability to add any language the school needs. This is more than a digital tool — it is a partnership that combines the school's expertise with Sawaed's technology to build a complete digital future for the school.
School.Intro.Highlight1: A private school social network — bringing the engagement of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and WhatsApp together in one safe educational space inside your school. No strangers, no ads, and no inappropriate or illegal content — a protected environment where children can enjoy the benefits of social interaction without the usual risks.
School.Intro.Highlight2: Sawaed AI — personal AI that understands and analyzes real student data, answers based on it, and provides guidance to students and parents.
School.Intro.HighlightNote: These are not just add-ons; they are the reasons families choose to engage with the platform.
School.Intro.Highlight3: Your school's own app on the App Store and Google Play — trusted, secure, and branded for your school.
School.Branding.Title: Your School's Own App — Your Identity, Your Name, Your App Stores
School.Branding.Lead: Sawaed gives your school a digital application carrying its name, logo, and visual identity, available to parents and students through the App Store, Google Play, and the web. Users search for their school's name, find its app, and get a digital experience designed specifically for the school community.
School.Branding.AppStore.Title: An Official Presence on App Stores
School.Branding.AppStore.Item1: An application carrying the school's name and identity, available through the Apple App Store and Google Play.
School.Branding.AppStore.Item2: Parents and students can easily find the application by searching for the school's name.
School.Branding.AppStore.Item3: The school's identity, logo, and name are an integral part of the app experience, strengthening its digital presence.
School.Branding.Verified.Title: A Trusted and Secure Experience
School.Branding.Verified.Item1: The application goes through the publishing and review requirements of the app stores before being made available to users.
School.Branding.Verified.Item2: The platform is designed with a strong focus on protecting student, parent, and school staff data.
School.Branding.Verified.Item3: Data access and management permissions are designed around user roles and the school's needs.
School.Branding.Marketing.Title: A Digital Identity That Strengthens Your School's Presence
School.Branding.Marketing.Item1: Having an app carrying the school's name and identity reflects its commitment to innovation and digital transformation.
School.Branding.Marketing.Item2: The app becomes the primary digital access point for families to interact with the school and its services.
School.Branding.Marketing.Item3: It gives the school a distinctive digital presence and helps create a more professional and connected experience for its community.
School.Branding.Data.Title: Your School's Data, Under Your Management
School.Branding.Data.Item1: The school's and community's data remain within the school's management and authorization framework, according to the applicable policies and agreements.
School.Branding.Data.Item2: Data access is governed by roles and permissions, with important administrative activities traceable when needed.
School.Branding.Data.Item3: The platform provides tools to manage and access data, giving the school greater visibility and control over its information.
School.Branding.Result: More than an app — it is a digital presence carrying your school's name and identity, giving students and parents a modern school experience while strengthening the school's image and helping it stand out in the digital education landscape.
School.Social.Title: The School's Digital Community
School.Social.Lead: Students, parents, and teachers are increasingly used to engaging with digital content every day. Sawaed brings a modern social experience into the heart of the school community through a feed of posts, stories, reels, and interactions — within a digital space dedicated to the school and managed and supervised by it.
School.Social.Feed.Title: A Vibrant School Feed
School.Social.Feed.Item1: An interactive feed featuring posts from the school, teachers, and staff, including photos, videos, and text content.
School.Social.Feed.Item2: Social interactions that encourage students and parents to participate and celebrate achievements, events, and memorable moments.
School.Social.Feed.Item3: Comments and discussions that allow the school community to engage with content in a dedicated and supervised environment.
School.Social.Stories.Title: Stories & Reels
School.Social.Stories.Item1: Short stories for sharing news, daily moments, and quick updates from the school.
School.Social.Stories.Item2: School reels showcasing events, activities, sports, celebrations, and achievements in an engaging format.
School.Social.Stories.Item3: Visibility into content engagement and reach across the school community.
School.Social.Engagement.Title: Engagement Beyond Announcements
School.Social.Engagement.Item1: Interactive polls that help the school understand community opinions and make better decisions, such as trip preferences, event choices, and schedules.
School.Social.Engagement.Item2: Turn communication from one-way announcements into ongoing dialogue and interaction between the school, students, and parents.
School.Social.Targeting.Title: Content That Reaches the Right People
School.Social.Targeting.Item1: Target content to the entire school or specific groups such as teachers, students, or parents.
School.Social.Targeting.Item2: Target content to a specific grade, section, or group as needed.
School.Social.Targeting.Item3: The right content reaches the right audience, such as class teacher updates shown only to the relevant students and families.
School.Social.Safety.Title: A Private Community Managed by the School
School.Social.Safety.Item1: A digital space dedicated to the school community, with control over who can access and interact with content.
School.Social.Safety.Item2: Moderation and management tools help the school control content, comments, and permissions according to its policies.
School.Social.Safety.Item3: Support for photos, videos, and rich media in a fast experience designed for everyday use.
School.Social.Result: Instead of being just another page in a world of competing content, the school gets its own digital social space where students, parents, and teachers can follow and engage with school news, events, and activities continuously.
School.AI.Title: Sawaed AI — An Intelligent Assistant That Understands You and Your School
School.AI.Lead: Sawaed AI is not just a chatbot that answers general questions. It is an intelligent assistant connected to school data, user context, and permissions. It understands who it is talking to, provides personalized answers, analyzes behavioral signals and interests, and helps users complete actions directly through conversation.
School.AI.Questions.Title: Ask About Your Child and Get a Real Answer
School.AI.Questions.Q1: "How many days has my son been absent this term?"
School.AI.Questions.Q2: "What assignments does my daughter have this week?"
School.AI.Questions.Q3: "How is my child's overall academic performance?"
School.AI.Questions.Q4: "What fees are due for my son and when are they due?"
School.AI.Questions.Q5: "What upcoming events and exams are relevant to my child?"
School.AI.Questions.Note: Sawaed AI understands the context of the question and retrieves relevant information from the school's systems to provide a direct, personalized answer — without navigating through multiple pages or contacting the school office.
School.AI.Data.Title: Understands the User, Their Data, and Their Permissions
School.AI.Data.Item1: Understands the user in the conversation and their role in the school, whether parent, student, teacher, or administrator.
School.AI.Data.Item2: Understands the students linked to a parent so it can accurately identify which child the question refers to.
School.AI.Data.Item3: Uses attendance, absence, assignments, subjects, grades, fees, events, and other information the user is authorized to access.
School.AI.Data.Item4: Provides answers based on the user's context and permissions rather than generic information unrelated to their situation.
School.AI.Behavior.Title: Understands Student Interests and Tendencies
School.AI.Behavior.Item1: Analyzes available signals from the student's activity on the platform, such as the content they watch and interact with and the activities they show interest in.
School.AI.Behavior.Item2: Helps identify recurring interests and patterns in student behavior, such as interest in scientific, sports, or other areas.
School.AI.Behavior.Item3: Provides students and parents with indicators and guidance that can help them understand the student's interests and explore fields and pathways that may align with those tendencies.
School.AI.Behavior.Note: These indicators support decision-making; they do not replace the role of parents, teachers, or educational counselors in choosing the most appropriate path for the student.
School.AI.Personalization.Title: An Experience That Adapts to Every User
School.AI.Personalization.Item1: Adapts the conversation style to a student's age and educational stage, using explanations and language appropriate to their level of understanding.
School.AI.Personalization.Item2: Provides parents with clear, direct answers focused on their children and the information that matters to them.
School.AI.Personalization.Item3: Interacts with teachers and administrators according to their roles, permissions, and needs within the school.
School.AI.Personalization.Note: The same intelligence, with an experience designed for every user.
School.AI.Agent.Title: From Answers to Action
School.AI.Agent.Item1: Sawaed AI does not stop at answering; it can execute actions permitted by the user's permissions through conversation.
School.AI.Agent.Item2: A user can request an action such as submitting a leave request, and Sawaed AI understands the request and presents the details for confirmation before executing it.
School.AI.Agent.Item3: After the user confirms, the request is created and sent to the appropriate party for approval according to the school's workflow.
School.AI.Guide.Title: A Smart Guide to Using the App
School.AI.Guide.Item1: Ask Sawaed AI: "How do I create a new assignment?" and it will explain the steps inside the app.
School.AI.Guide.Item2: Ask: "How do I block a user?" and it will guide you to the correct location and steps to perform the action.
School.AI.Guide.Item3: Helps users discover and use platform features without searching manuals or contacting support.
School.AI.Guide.Note: Instead of learning how to use the system, just talk to it.
School.AI.Privacy.Title: Intelligence That Respects Privacy and Permissions
School.AI.Privacy.Item1: Sawaed AI operates according to user permissions and only reveals information the user is authorized to access.
School.AI.Privacy.Item2: Every query and action is processed within the context of the school, the signed-in user, and their permissions.
School.AI.Privacy.Item3: Available information and actions vary according to the user's role, whether parent, student, teacher, or administrator.
School.AI.Availability.Title: Your Assistant Whenever You Need It
School.AI.Availability.Item1: Available around the clock to answer questions and help users navigate and use the platform.
School.AI.Availability.Item2: Supports Arabic, English, and French, with the ability to add other languages according to the school's needs.
School.AI.Result: Sawaed AI transforms the app from a platform users need to learn into a platform they can simply talk to. It understands the user and their context, answers questions using real school data, helps identify student interests, guides users through the right steps, and can execute permitted actions after user confirmation.
School.FeatureFlags.Title: A Flexible Platform That Adapts to Your School
School.FeatureFlags.Lead: Not every school needs the same services or modules. Sawaed gives school management the ability to choose the features that fit its needs and enable or disable them from the administration panel. Start with what you need today and add more when you are ready, without rebuilding the app or changing the user experience.
School.FeatureFlags.HowItWorks.Title: How It Works
School.FeatureFlags.HowItWorks.Item1: School management can control key modules such as the social community, messaging, attendance, finance, transportation, Sawaed AI, and more.
School.FeatureFlags.HowItWorks.Item2: When a module is disabled, it disappears from the experience of users associated with the school, so each user sees only what has been enabled for them.
School.FeatureFlags.HowItWorks.Item3: Changes can be applied directly from the administration panel without requiring a new app release.
School.FeatureFlags.HowItWorks.Item4: Modules can be re-enabled at any time, allowing the school to expand gradually as its needs evolve.
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Title: Customizable Services
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Item1: Social community, stories, and reels — enable the school's social experience when ready.
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Item2: Sawaed AI — enable the intelligent assistant according to the school's needs.
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Item3: Finance and payments — enable fee and payment management when needed.
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Item4: Transportation — enable bus, journey, and tracking management for schools that provide transportation services.
School.FeatureFlags.Modules.Item5: Attendance, messaging, academics, and more — each module can be managed according to the school's needs.
School.FeatureFlags.Benefits.Title: Why This Flexibility Matters
School.FeatureFlags.Benefits.Item1: A clearer experience — users see only the services available to them, without being overwhelmed by features they do not need.
School.FeatureFlags.Benefits.Item2: Start with what you need today — then add new services gradually as the school's needs evolve.
School.FeatureFlags.Benefits.Item3: Greater platform flexibility — the school can change enabled services without changing or redistributing the application.
School.FeatureFlags.Control.Title: Administrative Control and Clear Permissions
School.FeatureFlags.Control.Item1: Module management is limited to authorized administrators according to their assigned permissions.
School.FeatureFlags.Control.Item2: Module status is enforced across the platform and services, so disabled modules are not available to unauthorized users.
School.FeatureFlags.Control.Item3: New modules and services can be developed in the future to meet the school's specific needs.
School.FeatureFlags.Result: The school does not need to change the way it works to fit the platform; the platform adapts to the school. Choose the services you need today and add more when you are ready — building the school's digital experience the way it works best for you.

School.Problems.title: Student Visibility
School.Problems.problem: Parents often lack a clear, direct view of their children's attendance, grades, assignments, and fees, which can allow issues to grow before they are discovered and addressed.
School.Problems.solution: One app gives every parent a clear, direct, and comprehensive view of their children's school experience — from grades, attendance, assignments, and school fees to activities, transportation, student engagement, and participation in school life. Everything parents need to stay informed and reassured.

School.Problems.title: More Organized Communication
School.Problems.problem: Communication is often spread across WhatsApp groups, Facebook pages, paper notices, and phone calls, making some messages easy to miss and information harder to access at the right time.
School.Problems.solution: One secure communication channel dedicated to the school, enabling targeted announcements and content, private messaging, and instant notifications to ensure information reaches the right people at the right time.

School.Problems.title: Instant Answers, More Time for the School Team
School.Problems.problem: School staff receive many repetitive questions from parents every day, such as: Has my child boarded the bus? Where is the school trip right now? What fees are due? When is the exam? This consumes staff time and increases pressure on the school team.
School.Problems.solution: Self-service features allow parents to access the information they need directly, supported by Sawaed AI, which understands school data and answers questions instantly, around the clock.

School.Problems.title: Stronger Engagement with the School Community
School.Problems.problem: When schools rely on public social media platforms, their content becomes part of a personal feed filled with unrelated content, making school posts harder to discover and reducing their visibility and impact.
School.Problems.solution: A private digital school community bringing parents, students, and teachers together in one place. Important news and announcements arrive directly through notifications, users can follow the calendar and upcoming events and activities, and a dedicated social feed shows school content only — strengthening engagement and making the app part of daily school life.

School.Problems.title: Faster Attendance and Real-Time Visibility
School.Problems.problem: Traditional attendance processes can take time, and attendance information may reach parents late, reducing the speed of follow-up.
School.Problems.solution: Fast digital attendance with instant parent notifications about their children's attendance and absence, keeping families informed at the right time.

School.Problems.title: Clearer Fee Management
School.Problems.problem: Managing school fees can require significant effort, especially with multiple invoices, payments, due dates, and approvals, making balances and payment status harder to track.
School.Problems.solution: Integrated digital fee management that lets the school create clear fee plans, issue invoices automatically, track payments, balances, and due dates, support multi-month payments in one transaction, and maintain a clear approval workflow and audit trail for every operation.

School.Problems.title: Safer, More Reassuring Transportation
School.Problems.problem: Parents want reassurance about their children's school journeys and need visibility into the trip status and bus location, especially during travel to and from school.
School.Problems.solution: A smart transportation system that provides live bus tracking, records and confirms each student's boarding and drop-off, and sends notifications that help parents follow the journey and stay reassured about their children.

School.Problems.title: A More Private School Community
School.Problems.problem: Public social media platforms are designed for broad audiences and diverse content, and do not provide the dedicated environment, privacy, and full control a school community of students, parents, and staff needs.
School.Problems.solution: A private digital community dedicated to the school, bringing students, parents, and staff together in a private and organized environment with permissions and full control over content and interactions, away from external content, advertising, and interactions.
